calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, status,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
       SUM(f.gross_amount) AS web_gross, COUNT(*) AS n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS n_distinct_lines,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS web_net
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = w.dispatch_date
WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2

SELECT s.store_id, f.channel_code, o.status, p.category = 'ZZ Test' AS test_sku,
       COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(f.gross_amount) AS gross,
       SUM(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate)) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vat_mismatch,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_ids
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-01' AND DATE '2024-11-05'
  AND (s.store_id = 900 OR f.channel_code = 'WB' OR o.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

calls.statement:
SELECT 'dup_receipt_line' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE store_key IN (SELECT store_key FROM dim_store WHERE store_id=900) GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'orders_without_lines_delivered_collected', COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order o WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'orders_with_null_dispatch', COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected') AND dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'lines_whose_order_missing', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_web_order o WHERE o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'order_total_vs_lines_mismatch_in_window', COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT o.web_order_id, o.order_total_gross, SUM(f.gross_amount) g FROM fact_web_order o JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
  WHERE o.dispatch_ts_utc BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2024-07-25' AND TIMESTAMP '2024-10-30' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING abs(o.order_total_gross - SUM(f.gross_amount))>0.05)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dim_date_rows_in_range', COUNT(*) FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6

SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS ctrl_net_before_returns
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
